services.desc: The 2022 Holiday Tours at Laurel Hill Mansion are 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Wednesday through Sunday, from December 1st through December 23rd. After Christmas there will still be opportunities to see Laurel Hill Mansion dressed for the Holidays on Wednesday December 28th, Thursday, December 29th and Friday December 30th. Steven Page will be playing the fortepiano on Saturday, December 10th from 1:00 P.M. to 1:45 P.M. in the historic octagonal music room of Laurel Hill Mansion. Don’t miss a rare opportunity to hear this English pianoforte from 1808 by Broadwood played. Then at about 2:30 P.M. approximately 35 members of Philomusica Choral will stop by Laurel Hill Mansion to sing. Steven Page

blurb: Laurel Hill Mansion is a pre-revolutionary house built in 1767 at the behest of Rebecca Rawle, a young Quaker widow with three small children. Its fascinating history includes Loyalist, Patriots, and a French Ambassador among others. Owned by the city of Philadelphia and operated by the non-profit Women for Greater Philadelphia the house is open Thursday through Sunday from 10:00a.m. to 4:00p.m.
